spatial_reference: Left, center, and right name the three fixed world-coordinate TS02 drawer slots, not positions in a camera image.

inspect_left.label: search the left drawer for the red cube, then close it

inspect_center.label: search the center drawer for the red cube, then close it

inspect_right.label: search the right drawer for the red cube, then close it
